# dnswiz_zone (Resource)

A DNS zone managed by dnswiz.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dnswiz_zone" "example" {
  name         = "example.com"
  default_ttl  = 300
  soa_rname    = "hostmaster@example.com"
  negative_ttl = 60
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Apex name of the zone, for example `example.com`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the zone is served. Defaults to `true`.
- `default_ttl` (Number) Default TTL in seconds for records in this zone that do not set their own. Omit to inherit the tenant default.
- `negative_ttl` (Number) Negative-cache TTL used in the SOA minimum field. Omit to inherit the tenant default.
- `soa_rname` (String) Responsible-person email used in the SOA record. Omit to inherit the tenant default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Zone ID assigned by dnswiz.
